rows.title: The live animals list is reframed in place, scoped to the trader's organisation, and plants' list takes the same frame
rows.detail: The live animals list stays at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend and takes Design Release 2.1's frame: the 'Dashboard' title and caption over the h1 'Live animals', a primary 'Create new' button straight under the heading in place of the introductory paragraph and the 'Start a new notification' button, the h2 'Notifications', and cards named for screen readers. Plants' own list loses its introductory paragraph and takes the same 'Notifications' heading and card names in the same increment. The animals backend's list starts refusing a caller that does not say which organisation it acts for, so a trader only ever sees their own organisation's notifications. The k6 journey script, which reads this page for its crumb and searches it by reference, keeps passing. Every later list row copies this frame.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in trader opening the live animals list at the live-animals set root sees the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Live animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-100; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-038; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-032, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-033; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-070)

On the live animals list the heading is followed directly by a primary 'Create new' button; there is no introductory paragraph, no Messages link and no 'Start a new notification' button. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-038-m1, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-040; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-004, repo-frontend-p3-005; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-068)

Pressing 'Create new' on the live animals list starts a new live animals notification with status Draft in the live-animals set and lands on that set's first journey page, with or without JavaScript; opening or reloading the list creates no draft. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-047, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-068; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-006, repo-frontend-p3-106; conflict c-251)

Plants' list has no introductory paragraph: its heading is followed directly by its start control, with no intro body and no guidance sentence. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-006, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-010, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-115, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-116; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076)

On the live animals list and on plants' list the notification cards sit under the h2 'Notifications'; the h2 'Your notifications' is gone from both lists. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-008; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-017; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-069, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076; conflict c-167)

Each card on the live animals list and on plants' list has the notification's reference as its h3 and is announced to screen readers as 'Notification <reference>'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-046; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-064, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-122; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-049; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-069, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076)

Signed in for one organisation, a trader sees only that organisation's notifications on the live animals list: a notification started under another organisation never appears, not even when its reference is searched; the animals backend's list API answers a request that does not say which organisation it acts for with a refusal, not a list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-003; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-137; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-095)

The k6 journey run against the stack still opens the live animals list at the live-animals set root for the crumb it posts back, creates a notification, searches the list for it by reference and finds the submitted notification's reference on the list, passing every check. (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-005, repo-perftests-p1-068, repo-perftests-p1-069; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-070; conflict c-225)

With Welsh chosen, every new or changed string on the live animals list and on plants' list shows its Welsh version, and each new Welsh string is marked as a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off under the Welsh Language Standards. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-068, repo-frontend-p3-069; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-008, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-009, repo-plantsfrontend-p9-161, repo-plantsfrontend-p9-162)

openQuestions: How 'Create new' carries the live animals category before the type question sits in front of it. Default: 'Create new' keeps today's form post, which creates a live animals draft in the live-animals set and lands on its first page, so the category is carried by the set the button belongs to; the category stored on the record comes with the category-on-create row (inc-176, req-1857), and the animals frontend names the address (c-251).
notes: Rewritten to the 9 October afternoon ruling (c-159; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-050, p3-065 to p3-070, p3-076): the list is reframed in place in the animals frontend on the animals backend's list, plants' list in the same increment. The INS frontend and the INS backend read model drop out of this row.

Combines the frame slices (title, caption, h1, Create new, 'Notifications', card names), the organisation scoping and the k6 check: one page, one review, and every later list row depends on the frame existing.

Taken out against the previous version: req-1032 (adopted as exists) and req-1035 (out of scope, c-298: no Back link on the list). 'Use template' (req-1038) moves to its own row, because it waits on the Manage templates page (inc-151).
Plants' browser title (req-2028) is named by req-1033 as built in this same increment but sits in no area in areas.json; the combiner should add it here.
req-1852 keeps the k6 suite passing; the list request does not move (p3-070). Where the search row renames the search parameter, that row carries the same k6 check.

Already met and kept, so not listed: the search keeps its text (req-1047), the card's status-driven actions (req-1084), no serious axe violations or sideways scroll (req-1091), deleted notifications never listed (req-1094), a new notification appears within seconds (req-1095), plants' session-scoped listing (req-1853).
Welsh (req-1090) sits here because this row first changes the list copy; every later list row adds Welsh drafts for its own strings under the envelope invariant.

rows.title: 'Use template' on the live animals list
rows.detail: The live animals list offers a secondary 'Use template' button beside 'Create new' that opens the Manage templates page, with no category. Plants' list has no such button, because templates cover only the animals sets. Kept apart from the frame row so the frame does not wait for the templates work that builds the page the button opens.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has a secondary 'Use template' button beside 'Create new'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-023; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-068)

Following 'Use template' opens the Manage templates page, with no category chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-023; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-041, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-079; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-010)
Plants' list has no 'Use template' button. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-044; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-127, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-128)
openQuestions: Which page 'the templates page' is. Default: the Manage templates page the templates work builds (inc-151); the button is a link to it, and this row waits until that page exists (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates p1-048 leaves where Manage templates lives open; the button follows wherever inc-151 puts it).
notes: New row: req-1038 was in inc-129. Split out because it needs the Manage templates page (inc-151) to be observable, and the frame row is a gate every other list row waits on.

Depends on inc-129 (the frame) and inc-151 (Manage templates). Theme caution for the combiner: inc-162 (Sort by on Manage templates) depends on inc-136 in this area, so putting this row in the list's theme makes the list theme and the templates theme depend on each other. Either inc-162 drops its dependency on inc-136 (its sort select only copies a pattern), or this row is placed so no cycle forms.

rows.title: Notification cards show Design Release 2.1's facts and status styles, on the live animals list and on plants' list
rows.detail: The live animals card leads with what is coming, when, to whom and its status: 'Commodity', 'Arrival date', 'Consignee' and 'Notification status', then 'Number of animals', 'Origin' and 'Consignor', read from the animals backend's record. Dates other than arrival go, the arrival date takes the full month name, an empty fact reads 'Not applicable', the commodity is the name on the notification, and only statuses that ask something of the trader are tags. Plants' card takes the same labels, date format, placeholder and status styles with its own facts, keeping its 'Late' tag.
acceptanceCriteria: A live animals card shows its facts in two rows: 'Commodity', 'Arrival date', 'Consignee' and 'Notification status', then 'Number of animals', 'Origin' and 'Consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-065, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-070; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-071; conflict c-167)

On the live animals card and on plants' card the arrival date is labelled 'Arrival date', not 'Arrival at destination' or 'Arrival'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-065; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-051, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-060; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076)

On both cards the status is labelled 'Notification status', not 'Status'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-065; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-051)

A live animals card shows 'Number of animals' with the count of animals on the notification as the animals backend holds it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-082; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-071)

Neither card shows 'Date created' or 'Date submitted'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-102; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-032, trace-e2e-p3-033; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-055, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-120)

On both cards the arrival date is written as the day, the full month name and the year, such as '21 June 2026'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-066; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-059; conflict c-164)

A card whose notification has no commodity, no arrival date or no quantity yet shows 'Not applicable' for that fact instead of a blank value, on both lists. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-056, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-101; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-056)

A live animals card's Commodity is the commodity name on the notification as the trader chose it, not the common name looked up for its code. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-056; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-094)

On the live animals card a draft's status is a 'Draft' tag, a notification being amended keeps its yellow 'Amending' tag, a notification the animals backend records as 'Submitted action required' shows an 'Action required' tag, and a submitted notification's status is the plain styled text 'Submitted', not a tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-062; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-067, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-068; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-071, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-072; conflict c-165)

On plants' card a draft's status is a 'Draft' tag and a submitted notification's status is the plain styled text 'Submitted', not a tag; a late notification keeps its 'Late' tag, and plants shows no 'Action required' status. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-061, repo-plantsfrontend-p9-128; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-077, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076; conflict c-301)

rows.title: The live animals list has 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed' tabs
rows.detail: The live animals list separates work in flight, unfinished drafts and finished notifications with three tabs built as MoJ sub navigation links. 'In progress' is the default and the only tab with a count; a notification being amended stays in 'In progress' with its 'Amending' tag. The animals backend's list API gains the category and tab filters and the 'In progress' count the tabs need.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has three tabs, 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed', built as MoJ sub navigation, each a link that loads the page with that tab chosen, with or without JavaScript; 'In progress' is the list with no tab chosen, and a missing or unknown tab shows 'In progress'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-061; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-042; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-103, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-105; conflict c-251, c-299)

Following a tab drops the search and sort: the chosen tab shows its notifications unsearched, in the default order. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-081)

'In progress' lists the organisation's submitted and action-required notifications and its notifications being amended, each amending one with its yellow 'Amending' tag and Resume, 'Copy as new', 'Cancel amendment' and Delete; it lists no draft. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-073; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-046, repo-frontend-p3-111; conflict c-165)

'Draft' lists only drafts, and 'Completed' lists no draft, submitted, action-required or amending notification. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-075)

Only 'In progress' shows a count, in bold brackets, such as 'In progress (2)', counting the notifications that tab lists; 'Draft' and 'Completed' show no count, even when selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-062; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-043)

Under the tabs the cards sit under an h3 naming the tab: 'Notifications in progress', 'Draft notifications' or 'Completed notifications'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-063; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-044, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-055, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-057)

The animals backend's list API filters by category (live animals or germinal products, a record with no category counting as live animals) and by tab (the in-progress statuses, drafts, or completed), and reports how many notifications the 'In progress' tab holds for that category; asked for germinal products, it returns none of the organisation's live animals notifications. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-066, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-073; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; conflict c-159)

notes: Rewritten to the 9 October afternoon ruling (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-105, p3-066, p3-073; c-159): the tabs are MoJ sub navigation on the animals frontend's own list, which already has the MoJ package (p1-049, p1-051), over the animals backend's list API, which gains the category filter. The tab parameter's name and values are the animals frontend's (c-251).
Combines the tab links, membership, amending placement, count, h3 and the API's category and tab filters: one control over one query.

Completed notifications cannot exist until the authorities' outcome feed (req-1082, blocked row), so 'Completed' is proven to hold none of the other statuses. The additional filters join the form in a later row, so following a tab dropping them is proven there.

Plants' list gets the tabs too under ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-076, but no requirement in this area asks for plants' tabs; if a plants tab requirement exists among the requirements no area holds, the combiner places it here or with the deferred plants-backend work (p3-055 to p3-056).

rows.title: The live animals list's search and sort become one form that really searches and sorts
rows.detail: The live animals list's search and sort move into one column above the tabs, in one GET form submitted by an icon-only search button. The search matches part of a reference, commodity, consignee or consignor in any case, and the sort offers 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', applied for real and stable across pages. The animals backend's list API does the matching and the ordering.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list the search and sort sit in one column above the tabs inside the 'Notifications' section; there is no 'Filter notifications' heading and no filter column beside the results. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-009, repo-frontend-p3-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-073; conflict c-167)

The search field is labelled 'Search by'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-046; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-039)

The search field has the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-046; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040)

The search is submitted by a real submit button that shows only a magnifying-glass icon and is announced to screen readers as 'Search'; a trader without JavaScript searches the same way. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-047; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101; conflict c-299)

Searching any part of a notification's reference number, commodity, consignee or consignor, in any case and with spaces around it, lists every notification of the organisation that contains it, paged like any other list; searching text that none contains lists none. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-010, repo-backend-p3-011, repo-backend-p3-012; conflict c-162)

Search and sort are one GET form to the list's own page, submitted by the search button, carrying the current tab (unless 'In progress') and the current page (when above 1), so the result stays on that tab; changing the sort select submits nothing by itself. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-049, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-050; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-058; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-046, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-047, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

The sort select is labelled 'Sort by:' and offers exactly 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', in that order, with no 'Select one' option. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-045; conflict c-161)

'Newest first' and 'Oldest first' order the cards by when each notification was created, 'Arrival date' by arrival date newest first, and with no sort chosen the cards are in arrival date order, newest first, with 'Arrival date' selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-060; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-047; conflict c-161, c-162)

Paging through a sorted list never shows a notification twice or leaves one out, even when several share the same created or arrival date, or have no arrival date. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-006, repo-backend-p3-009; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-092)

There is no 'Update sort' button: the search button applies the chosen sort, and the chosen sort stays selected after the page reloads. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-051; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

The k6 journey run against the stack still searches the live animals list for its notification by reference and finds the submitted notification's reference on it, passing every check. (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-068, repo-perftests-p1-069; conflict c-225)

rows.title: The live animals list has 'Additional filters' for arrival date, date range and status
rows.detail: Inside the one search form, a GOV.UK details 'Additional filters' disclosure holds arrival-date radios, a date range of two MoJ date pickers and a status select. Each filter is applied for real by the animals backend's list API, a date the filter cannot use is answered with a GOV.UK error, and every choice stays set after searching.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has an 'Additional filters' disclosure built from the GOV.UK details component inside the search form, closed when the page loads with no filter set and open whenever an arrival-date, date-range or status filter is set. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-054; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-049; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-106; conflict c-299)

A 'By arrival date' column offers small GOV.UK radios 'Today', 'Tomorrow' and 'Next 7 days' (the legend visually hidden, the same words shown as its heading); choosing one and searching lists only notifications arriving in that range, and the choice stays checked. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-055, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-060; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-050; conflict c-162)

A 'By date range' column has the hint 'For example, 27/3/2026' and two MoJ date pickers, 'Start date' and 'End date', each with a 'Choose date' calendar opening on the current month with weeks starting on Monday, and each a plain text field without JavaScript; searching lists only notifications arriving between the two dates, and the entered dates are kept. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-056, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-057, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-121; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-051, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-052; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-048, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-106, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-107; conflict c-162)

A start date alone lists notifications arriving on or after it, and an end date alone those arriving on or before it. (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-002, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-006; conflict c-162)

When the start date cannot be read as a date the list shows a GOV.UK error summary and an inline error 'Enter a real start date'; when the end date cannot, 'Enter a real end date'; when the end date is before the start date, 'End date must be the same as or after the start date'. In each case 'Additional filters' is open, the entered text stays in the 'Start date' and 'End date' pickers, and the list is shown without the date-range filter. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-107; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-047; conflict c-166)

A 'Status' select offers exactly 'Select one', 'Action required', 'Submitted' and 'Completed'; choosing a status and searching lists only notifications in it, and the choice stays selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-035; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-058; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-053; conflict c-162)

The filters apply together with the search, the sort and the current tab, all submitted by the search button; choosing a radio or a status submits nothing by itself, and following a tab drops the filters. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-036, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-106; conflict c-162)

notes: Rewritten to the 9 October afternoon ruling (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-051, p1-106, p1-107; c-299): built from GOV.UK details, radios and a select and the MoJ date picker on the animals frontend's own list, which already has the MoJ package; no custom JavaScript; the animals backend's list API gains the status and arrival-date filters.
Combines the disclosure, the three filter columns, the date validation and the API filters: one section of one form over one query.

The 'Action required' option lists what the animals backend records as 'Submitted action required' (inc-113), and 'Completed' lists nothing until the authorities' outcome feed exists (req-1082, blocked row); both options render and filter now. The prototype's lack of date validation is overruled (c-166).

rows.title: The lists page 8 at a time with numbered pages, and lose the results line and empty messages
rows.detail: The live animals list shows 8 notifications a page with GOV.UK numbered pagination, clamps a stale or hand-typed page, and keeps the tab, sort, search and filters on every page link. The results-count line and both empty-state messages go. Plants' list takes the numbered pagination and loses the same lines in the same increment. The animals backend's list API serves 8 a page with its totals.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows 8 notifications a page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-073)

On the live animals list and on plants' list, a list of more than one page shows GOV.UK pagination with numbered page links, a 'Previous' link from page 2 and a 'Next' link on every page before the last; a list of one page, or with no results, shows no pagination. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-042; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-046, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-047; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076)

On the live animals list a page number below 1 or not a number shows page 1, and a page past the last shows the last page; plants' list keeps doing the same. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-004; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-041, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-042)

The live animals list's page links keep the tab (unless 'In progress'), the sort (unless the default), the search text and every additional filter. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-031, repo-frontend-p3-034; conflict c-163)

Neither list shows a results count: no 'Showing 1 Result', 'Showing S to E of T Results', 'Showing N of T Results' or 'No Results' line, in English or Welsh. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-044; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-077; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-028, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076; conflict c-167)

On either list, a search that matches nothing shows an empty list with no message; 'No notifications found' is gone. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-045; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-024, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-125; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-021)

On either list, a tab or list with no notifications shows an empty list with no message; 'You have not started any notifications in this session.' and its Welsh twin are gone. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-045; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-026, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-027; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076; conflict c-300)

The animals backend's list API serves 8 notifications a page, numbered from 1, and reports the page, size, number of elements, total elements and total pages. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-004, repo-backend-p3-005, repo-backend-p3-014, repo-backend-p3-077)

Combines page size, numbered pagination, out-of-range pages, page links keeping the list's state, and the three removed lines: they all sit below the cards and are proven with the same multi-page set-up. Depends on the search-and-sort and additional-filters rows, since page links carry what they add.
Plants' page size is not changed by any requirement here. The prototype's page links dropping the search and filters are overruled (c-163).

rows.title: The live animals list's Summary shows 'Action needed' and 'Status updated' glance cards
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 puts what needs the trader's attention at the top of each category list: an h2 'Summary' with an 'Action needed' card and a 'Status updated' card, each with a live count and a link to its drill-down. The 9 October afternoon ruling counts these as the INS dashboard's summary information, blocked until its requirements firm up.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has an h2 'Summary' with an 'Action needed' glance card reading 'Tasks requiring your attention' and a 'View tasks' link that opens the Action needed page showing only live animals notifications. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-024; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-042, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-043; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-036, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-037)

The Summary has a 'Status updated' glance card reading 'Changes in the past 24 hours' and a 'View updates' link that opens the Status updated page showing only live animals notifications. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-024; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-044; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-038)

The 'Action needed' card shows the number of the organisation's live animals notifications showing the 'Action required' tag, a 'Delayed' one not counted, the same number its 'View tasks' link lists. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-123; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-031; conflict c-148, c-149)
openQuestions: Blocked: the INS dashboard's requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-057, p3-060; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates p1-002 to p1-007). Who: Sam and the people the INS dashboard's requirements are agreed with; once they exist this summary area is re-distilled, and what the Summary shows, where its counts come from and which drill-downs it links to are decided then.
notes: Was todo; now blocked by the 9 October afternoon ruling (p3-060), which counts the list's Summary cards as summary information. Nothing in the reframed list depends on this row (p3-079).

Repos are the animals backend, animals frontend and tests, because the list it sits on stays in the animals frontend; re-check on the re-distil. The 'Delayed' exclusion has nothing to exclude until the authorities' outcome feed exists (blocked outcomes row). DR2.1's fixed glance numbers are overruled (c-148).

rows.title: The lists' success banner is titled 'Success', on the live animals list and on plants' list
rows.detail: After an action that sends the trader back to the list with its flag on the redirect, such as a delete, the list shows one GOV.UK success banner titled 'Success' carrying that action's message, on the live animals list and on plants' list.
acceptanceCriteria: When an action sends the trader back to the live animals list with its success flag on the redirect, such as a delete from a card, the list shows a GOV.UK success notification banner with role alert, titled 'Success', carrying that action's message. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-020; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-062, repo-frontend-p3-064, repo-frontend-p3-136; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-085, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-074; conflict c-252)

After a delete on plants' list, its banner is titled 'Success'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-054; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-081, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-082, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-122)
No list banner, on either list, is titled 'Notification deleted' or 'Notification copied'. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-063, repo-frontend-p3-065; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-081)
Opening either list with no action's success flag shows no success banner. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-062; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-082)
notes: Rewritten to the 9 October afternoon ruling (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-052, p3-054, p3-074, p3-083): a delete lands on the set's own list, so the banner shows on the live animals list and plants' list, and this row moves with inc-126 into the reframed list's theme. The INS frontend leaves this row.
The banner's message is the action's own: inc-126 (manage-notifications) sets the delete's message, 'Notification has been deleted' on plants (p3-053). Depends on inc-129 and inc-126.

Kept as they are (already met): the banner does not dismiss itself (req-1088, c-006), and the stale-action and 'There is a problem' banners (req-1089). req-1087 (a held, show-once message) is out of scope (c-252).

rows.title: The germinal products set's root renders its own copy of the reframed list
rows.detail: The germinal products set's root in the animals frontend renders its own notification list, a copy of the reframed live animals list: the 'Dashboard' caption, the h1 'Germinal products', 'Create new' starting a germinal products notification, 'Use template', and the same search, sort, additional filters, tabs and paging pointed at its own address. It shows only germinal products notifications, read from the animals backend's list filtered by category.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in trader opening the germinal products set's root sees its notification list, with the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Germinal products'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-078; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-086, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087)

Pressing its 'Create new' starts a new germinal products notification in the germinal products set and lands on that set's first journey page; its 'Use template' opens the Manage templates page. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-079; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-010; conflict c-251)

Its search, sort, additional filters, tabs and page links work as on the live animals list and all keep the trader on the germinal products list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-081, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087)

The germinal products list shows only germinal products notifications: none of the organisation's live animals notifications appears on it, in its search results or in its 'In progress' count. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-088)

sources.ref: germinal products list (trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-078, p1-079, p1-081, p1-087)

notes: Rewritten to the 9 October afternoon ruling (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-086, p3-087; c-159): the germinal list is the germinal set's own copy of the reframed live animals list in the animals frontend, and it moves to the germinal-products theme. The INS backend and INS frontend leave this row; the animals backend's category filter is built in the tabs row (inc-135).

Now covers req-1851 (the germinal set root renders its own list), moved here from inc-176: the root's list is this row. The combiner should take req-1851 out of inc-176, drop inc-176's criterion about what the germinal set root does with its list, and drop inc-176's dependency on inc-141, which now depends on inc-176 instead (p3-089 has inc-176 depend on inc-129 and inc-130).

Depends on inc-176 (the germinal set exists), and on the list rows it copies: inc-129, the new 'Use template' row, inc-130, inc-135, inc-136, inc-137, inc-138 and inc-140. No Summary: it is blocked with inc-139.
Copies the live animals list's feature folder into the germinal set, as the germinal set's other pages are copied (Option B).

rows.title: Germinal products notifications on their own list, with their own card facts
rows.detail: A germinal products notification appears only on the germinal products list, never on the live animals list, and its card counts packages and names the species and product type. The animals backend's list item returns everything the cards show, for both categories.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification appears on the germinal products list and never on the live animals list, in its search results or in its 'In progress' count; a notification whose stored record holds no category stays on the live animals list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-093; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013)

A germinal products notification's card shows its quantity as 'Number of packages', from the notification's package count. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-058; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-082; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-064; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-088)

A germinal products notification's card names the commodity as the species then the product type, separated by a comma, such as 'Cattle, Semen'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-083; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-088)

A germinal products notification with no package count or no commodity yet shows 'Not applicable' for that fact. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-101)

The animals backend's list returns, for each notification, its category and its number of animals, or for germinal products its number of packages and each line's species and product type, beside its reference number, status, commodity name, arrival date, origin, consignee name and consignor name, with a missing fact returned as empty. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-071, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-088; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015, repo-backend-p3-016, repo-backend-p3-017, repo-backend-p3-078)

sources.ref: NotificationView list item and list filter (repo-backend-p3-013, p3-015 to p3-017, p3-078)

notes: Rewritten to the 9 October afternoon ruling (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-088, p3-093): the germinal cards are built on the germinal set's copy of the list from the animals backend's record (category, species, product type and packages), and the row moves to the germinal-products theme. The INS read model leaves this row.

Now also covers req-1098 (the list item's full shape): its germinal facts can only be shown once a germinal notification with species, product type and packages exists, so it sits with the cards that show them; the live half (number of animals, commodity name) is what inc-130 shows.

Ordering need for the combiner: this row depends on inc-141 and inc-130, and on the germinal-products rows that first store a germinal notification's species, product type and package count; make it depend on whichever rows create them.

rows.title: Cards show the authorities' outcomes: delayed, completed, inspection, their actions and the status-updated count
rows.detail: Once the authorities' case system sends post-submission outcomes back to the notification record, the live animals card shows a 'Delayed' error card with its reason, a 'Completed' status in plain text and the 'Completed' tab, an 'Inspection' fact, and 'Copy as new' then 'View' on those cards; the Summary's 'Status updated' card counts the status changes. None of these statuses reaches the service today.
acceptanceCriteria: A delayed notification shows a 'Delayed' tag on an error card with the reason for the delay; the text 'Error message' never appears. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-052, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-065)

A notification the authorities have finished with shows the status 'Completed' as plain styled text, not a tag, and is listed in the 'Completed' tab. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-068; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-032; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-072, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-049)

A notification chosen for inspection shows an extra 'Inspection' fact with a 'Required' tag at the end of the card's second row. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-069)

A card in a delayed or completed status, or action required by the authorities, offers 'Copy as new' then 'View', View opening the notification's review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-047, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-048, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-049; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-048; conflict c-160)

The list's 'Status updated' glance card shows the number of the category's notifications whose status changed in the past 24 hours, matching the Status updated list its link opens. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-123; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-062; conflict c-148)

sources.ref: dashboard card statuses and actions (prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, p13-047 to p13-049, p13-052, p13-054, p13-061, p13-065, p13-069)

openQuestions: Blocked: the authorities' case system (PIMS Dynamics) must send post-submission outcomes (action required with its reason, inspection required, delayed, completed) back to the notification record. Who: the PIMS Dynamics integration owners must provide that outcome feed; until they do, no notification reaches these statuses and none of this can be built or observed (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p2-078, p3-049 leave what unblocks 'Completed' open).

Blocked as well, for the 'Status updated' count (req-1735): the INS dashboard's requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-062). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with; the count is re-distilled with the summary information.
Whether plants' card follows the 'Completed' status is decided when it unblocks (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-049).
notes: Keeps every requirement the PIMS outcome feed blocks apart, so the list rows build now. Rewritten to the 9 October afternoon ruling: once unblocked, the animals backend's record takes the outcomes (statuses are only ever added, p2-072, and mapped in the animals frontend before the backend sends them, p2-074) and the animals frontend's card, tabs and status filter pick them up; the INS read model leaves this row.

rows.title: Each set records its category when it creates a draft
rows.detail: The live-animals set creates each draft with the category live animals and the germinal products set with the category germinal products, so each notification reaches its own set's list. A record with no category still counts as live animals, so older drafts stay on the live animals list. This is this area's share of the germinal set's first row, inc-176, which builds the category on the stored record.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a live animals notification from the live animals list records the category live animals on the stored notification; a stored notification with no category is read as live animals and stays on the live animals list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015)

A draft the germinal products set creates holds the category germinal products on its stored record, as the animals backend's read of that notification returns it. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030)
notes: Draft for merging into inc-176 (the germinal set's first row, drafted by the germinal set's area), which already holds req-1856 and req-1857 because the category is one backend field both sets send on create and both guards read. The combiner keeps inc-176's id and merges these criteria into it, rather than making a separate row.

Under the 9 October afternoon ruling the category is stored on the record and not published on the notification event (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-092 to p3-094); inc-176's criterion about the category on outbox events and the INS backend no longer holds and should go.
